interpretations: Include every customer in the average share, treating customers without invoices as having spent zero; return the three requested averages for customers above that share.
Include only customers with at least one invoice when calculating the average share; return the three requested averages for invoiced customers above that share.
raw:
Include every customer in the average share, treating customers without invoices as having spent zero; return the three requested averages for customers above that share.

Include only customers with at least one invoice when calculating the average share; return the three requested averages for invoiced customers above that share.
